name: graftyard
description: A film built from code: one beat-locked timeline drives picture and sound.

scripts.stills: remotion still Mark16 out/stills/mark-16.png --log=error && remotion still MarkSizes out/stills/mark-sizes.png --log=error && remotion still MarkLarge out/stills/mark-large.png --log=error
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/lint-film.mjs src && tsx scripts/grid-check.ts src/timeline.ts && tsx scripts/grid-check.ts src/ghes/timeline.ts && tsx scripts/grid-check.ts src/chaos/timeline.ts && tsx scripts/grid-check.ts src/agents/timeline.ts
scripts.audio: node scripts/py.mjs scripts/audio/plan.py --quiet && node scripts/py.mjs scripts/audio/score.py --cues out/cues.json --score audio/score.json --out public/audio/soundtrack.wav --stems out/stems --json out/qa/score.json
scripts.gates: node scripts/py.mjs scripts/forensics.py out/draft.mp4 --cues out/cues.json --grammar-only --json out/qa/forensics-draft.json; node scripts/py.mjs scripts/copy-check.py --ui src; node scripts/logos.mjs check
scripts.qa: mkdir -p out/qa && node scripts/py.mjs scripts/probe.py out/film.mp4 --spec 1350x1080@30 && node scripts/py.mjs scripts/forensics.py out/film.mp4 --cues out/cues.json --json out/qa/forensics.json && node scripts/py.mjs scripts/av-audit.py out/film.mp4 --cues out/cues.json --stems out/stems --json out/qa/av.json && node scripts/py.mjs scripts/sheet.py out/film.mp4 --out out/qa/sheet.png
scripts.loop: bash scripts/render.sh Film out/loop.mp4 --loop --no-audio --jpeg && bash scripts/render.sh Film out/loop.mp4 --clean && mkdir -p ../public/film && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/loop.mp4 -c copy -an -movflags +faststart ../public/film/push-loop.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/loop.mp4 -an -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 26 -b:v 0 -row-mt 1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -colorspace bt709 ../public/film/push-loop.webm && node scripts/frames.mjs still 195 --scale 1 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/stills/f0195.png -q:v 3 ../public/film/push-loop.jpg
scripts.loop:ghes: bash scripts/render.sh Ghes out/ghes-loop.mp4 --loop --no-audio --jpeg && bash scripts/render.sh Ghes out/ghes-loop.mp4 --clean && mkdir -p ../public/film && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/ghes-loop.mp4 -c copy -an -movflags +faststart ../public/film/ghes-loop.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/ghes-loop.mp4 -an -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 26 -b:v 0 -row-mt 1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -colorspace bt709 ../public/film/ghes-loop.webm && node scripts/frames.mjs still 255 --comp Ghes --scale 1 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/stills/Ghes-f0255.png -q:v 3 ../public/film/ghes-loop.jpg
scripts.loop:chaos: bash scripts/render.sh Chaos out/chaos-loop.mp4 --loop --no-audio --jpeg && bash scripts/render.sh Chaos out/chaos-loop.mp4 --clean && mkdir -p ../public/film && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/chaos-loop.mp4 -c copy -an -movflags +faststart ../public/film/chaos-loop.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/chaos-loop.mp4 -an -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 26 -b:v 0 -row-mt 1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -colorspace bt709 ../public/film/chaos-loop.webm && node scripts/frames.mjs still 225 --comp Chaos --scale 1 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/stills/Chaos-f0225.png -q:v 3 ../public/film/chaos-loop.jpg
scripts.loop:agents: bash scripts/render.sh Agents out/agents-loop.mp4 --loop --no-audio --jpeg && bash scripts/render.sh Agents out/agents-loop.mp4 --clean && mkdir -p ../public/film && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/agents-loop.mp4 -c copy -an -movflags +faststart ../public/film/agents-loop.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/agents-loop.mp4 -an -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 26 -b:v 0 -row-mt 1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -colorspace bt709 ../public/film/agents-loop.webm && node scripts/frames.mjs still 255 --comp Agents --scale 1 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/stills/Agents-f0255.png -q:v 3 ../public/film/agents-loop.jpg
